description: This file defines the interface for a storage service management class (`hostIf_StorageSrvc`) that provides APIs and class methods for handling storage-related information within a TR-069 compliant device. It includes method declarations for managing instances, retrieving and setting storage attributes, and thread safety mechanisms.

classes.name: hostIf_StorageSrvc
classes.description: A singleton class that manages storage service information, instances, and thread safety for TR-069 storage device interface.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of the storage service class for a given device ID.

methods.name: closeInstance
methods.description: Closes and cleans up a specific storage service instance.

methods.name: getAllInstances
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all active storage service instances.

methods.name: closeAllInstances
methods.description: Closes all active storage service instances.

methods.name: get_Device_StorageSrvc_ClientNumberOfEntries
methods.description: Returns the number of storage service client entries.

methods.name: handleGetMsg
methods.description: Handles 'get' message requests related to storage service attributes.

methods.name: handleSetMsg
methods.description: Handles 'set' message requests for storage service attributes.

methods.name: getLock
methods.description: Acquires a thread lock for safe concurrent access.

methods.name: releaseLock
methods.description: Releases the previously acquired thread lock.
